newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On mulls listing units in early 1997 -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Shui On mulls listing units in early 1997 -- paper.

text.p: Shui On Holdings Ltd was mulling the listing of units Shui On (Contractors) Ltd and Shui On Contractors Materials Ltd on the Hong Kong bourse in early 1997, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Monday.

Proceeds raised from the spinoff would be used to fund purchase of building materials businesses in China, including a 50 percent interest in a cement production plant in Nanjing for HK$300 million to HK$400 million, the report said.
It gave no further details on the possible listings.
Shui On officials were not available for comment.
